title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Flatlines above 110.00, bearish outlook persists
summary: The AUD/JPY cross trades on a flat note around 110.20 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. Markets might turn cautious ahead of the Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate decision later on Friday.

title: WTI Price Forecast: Retakes $99.00 as bulls eye further gains amid Middle East jitters
summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts fresh buyers following the previous day's two-way price swings and climbs back above the $99.00 mark during the Asian session on Tuesday.
